page: Amazon Web Services m8id.8xlarge is a general-purpose server instance built on the Nitro hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 6975P-C processor with 16 physical cores and a base clock speed of 3.9 GHz. The architecture is x86_64, supported by a 480 MB L3 cache. Memory configuration includes 128.0 GB of DDR5 RAM operating at 7 GHz, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of memory per core.

For local storage, the instance includes a bundled 1900 GB NVMe SSD instance store volume, which provides high-speed local block storage. Network connectivity is established with a baseline bandwidth of 15 Gbps. The CPU architecture supports advanced instruction sets including AVX-512, Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX) for tile and int8 operations, and cryptographic acceleration via VAES and SHA_NI.

Performance benchmarks indicate strong capabilities across multiple domains. The system achieves a Geekbench single-core score of 2208.0 and a multi-core score of 18435.0, with notable strength in text processing and image processing. In cryptographic tests, the Passmark CPU encryption score reaches 36349.76. LLM inference benchmarks show strong prompt processing speeds of 218.35 tokens per second for a medium 7B model, and top-tier text generation performance of 374.61 tokens per second on a small 135M model.

This hardware profile offers high qualitative cost efficiency for workloads requiring a balance of compute, memory, and fast local storage without the overhead of external network-attached volumes. The combination of DDR5 memory, dedicated Intel Xeon cores, and integrated NVMe SSD storage makes this instance well-suited for database operations, web serving, software compilation, and moderate machine learning inference tasks.
